Incoterms 2020

Поручение на выдачу

A document issued by carrier or agent instructing terminal or warehouse to release cargo to the consignee or their agent.

Questions and answers

What is Поручение на выдачу?

In this glossary, Поручение на выдачу refers to: A document issued by carrier or agent instructing terminal or warehouse to release cargo to the consignee or their agent.

How is Поручение на выдачу used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Экспедитор предоставил поручение на выдачу на терминале для получения импортных товаров."

Definition

A document issued by carrier or agent instructing terminal or warehouse to release cargo to the consignee or their agent.

Operational example

The freight forwarder presented the delivery order at the container terminal to obtain release of the imported goods.
